skill.name: langgraph-docs
skill.description: Fetch and use LangGraph documentation to answer implementation, concept, tutorial, and API questions with current source material.
skill.summary: Find relevant LangGraph documentation and use it to provide accurate guidance.
skill.author: langchain-ai

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a hardcoded LangChain documentation index URL in SKILL.md:17. This is expected for a documentation lookup skill, and I found no evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable code, or unsafe tool use.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL points to the LangChain documentation index used by the skill to select relevant LangGraph docs. The file contains no instructions to transmit user data, secrets, or local files to that endpoint.

content.user_title: Answer LangGraph Questions with Current Docs
content.value_statement: LangGraph users need answers that reflect current documentation. This skill finds relevant LangGraph pages and uses them to guide accurate responses.
actual_capabilities: Fetches the LangChain documentation index for LangGraph-related requests.
Selects two to four relevant documentation pages based on the user question.
Prioritizes how-to guides, concepts, tutorials, and API references by request type.
Uses selected documentation pages to support implementation guidance.
Helps answer LangGraph Python questions with current documentation context.
limitations: Requires network access to fetch the documentation index and selected pages.
Depends on the availability and accuracy of LangChain documentation.
Does not execute LangGraph code or validate runtime behavior.
Focuses on LangGraph documentation and may not cover unrelated LangChain topics.

use_cases.title: Implement LangGraph Features
use_cases.description: Find relevant how-to documentation before building persistence, streaming, routing, or human review workflows.

use_cases.title: Understand LangGraph Concepts
use_cases.description: Use concept pages to explain graphs, state, nodes, edges, and agent workflow patterns.

use_cases.title: Review API Choices
use_cases.description: Consult current reference pages before choosing methods, configuration options, or integration patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Concept
prompt_templates.prompt: Use langgraph-docs to explain LangGraph state in simple terms. Include the most relevant documentation sources you used.

prompt_templates.title: Find an Implementation Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use langgraph-docs to find the best current documentation for adding persistence to a LangGraph Python application.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Use langgraph-docs to compare LangGraph routing approaches for a multi-step agent workflow. Explain when each approach fits.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use langgraph-docs to design a production LangGraph workflow with checkpointing, streaming, and human review. Cite the documentation areas you used.

output_examples.input: How should I add persistence to my LangGraph app?
output_examples.output: The response identifies persistence and checkpointing documentation, explains the main concepts, and lists practical implementation steps.

output_examples.input: What documentation should I read before building a human-in-the-loop workflow?
output_examples.output: The response selects relevant how-to and concept pages, then summarizes the workflow decisions to review before implementation.

output_examples.input: Help me choose between LangGraph routing patterns.
output_examples.output: The response compares documented routing patterns and maps each option to common application needs.

best_practices: Ask a specific LangGraph question so the skill can select targeted documentation pages.
Request documentation-backed answers when accuracy matters for implementation details.
Mention your language, framework context, and workflow goal when asking for guidance.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for unrelated libraries or general Python questions.
Expecting it to run code, inspect your repository, or verify deployment behavior.
Asking for current guidance while blocking access to the documentation website.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It fetches the LangGraph documentation index, selects relevant pages, and uses them to answer LangGraph questions.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs network access to read the LangChain documentation index and selected documentation pages.

faq.question: Can it answer API questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prioritize reference documentation when the user asks about API details or configuration options.

faq.question: Can it validate my LangGraph code?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation-based guidance but does not execute code or confirm runtime behavior.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the hardcoded URL unsafe?
faq.answer: No evidence of unsafe use was found. The URL points to the LangChain documentation index required by the skill.
